title: Chapter 610 - 610 Attack; Regrow Limbs!
content:
Chapter 610 - 610 Attack; Regrow Limbs!

Chapter 610 - 610 Attack; Regrow Limbs!

610 Attack; Regrow Limbs!

When many people first saw the desert, they found it very novel.

However, as time passed, it became dull and boring.

This was because other than the yellow sand that filled the sky, it was very difficult to see any other animals or plants.

People in the desert would get tired easily.

Dehydration and heatstroke occurred from time to time in the desert.

Fortunately, the heroes selected from each country had all obtained at least one treasure chest. Some of them had spiritual power, some had physical strength that far surpassed Superman, and some had special abilities.

This also allowed them to last longer in the desert.

Abraham was one of the heroes of Bear Country.

A gust of wind swept over the sand.

Abraham did not have time to cover his mouth and nose with his hand.

“Damn it, it’s all sand!” he spat.

Then, he looked into the distance and said, “When can we leave this place?”

Abraham could only lower his head and continue walking forward.

…

In Bear Country’s live broadcast room.

The host sighed and said, “I hope Abraham can walk out of the desert as soon as possible.”

Alison: [God bless!]

Dodge: [The temperature in the desert is high during the day, and it’ll usually be very cold at night. I hope Abraham can persevere. I’ll pray for him.]

Hunter: [Sigh, if only Abraham followed Lin Fan last time.]

Heiss: [Yeah. I just saw Hua Nation’s live broadcast. Lin Fan created large hail in the desert. If you follow Lin Fan, you won’t feel hot in the desert at all.]

Abbott: [Desert hail? Heavens! That’s so amazing! Is Lin Fan really a god?]

Marlin: [I think even God isn’t as powerful as him.]

Girukos: [Now, I only beg Abraham not to encounter any terrifying monsters.]

…

However, sometimes, the more one worried about something, the easier it was for it to happen.

At this moment, a giant scorpion that was about five meters tall and covered in gold suddenly jumped out of the sand in front of Abraham.

A terrifying baleful aura surged out, stirring up the yellow sand that filled the sky.

Then, the giant scorpion raised its steel pincers and smashed them at Abraham.

Abraham’s expression changed drastically, and he quickly dodged to the side.

Finally, he managed to dodge.

Sand and stones flew everywhere, and the entire scene immediately turned gray.

After missing its first attack, the giant scorpion raised its steel pincers and smashed down again.

Abraham dodged again.

Although the giant scorpion was big and heavy, it was still a giant scorpion.

However, its speed was not slow at all.

After dodging a few times, Abraham’s reaction slowed down.

So much so that…

When the giant scorpion smashed down with its steel pincers again, the sharp steel pincers hit Abraham’s right leg.

His right leg fell neatly onto the desert. Blood spurted out, and a miserable howl spread out.

The giant scorpion did not care about Abraham’s screams at all. It raised its steel pincers and was about to hit Abraham’s head.

At this moment, a dazzling light shot over from afar.

The next moment, the giant scorpion’s steel pincers broke and fell to the ground.

Just as the giant scorpion was in a daze and was at a loss, its body split into two from the middle and fell to the ground with a dull sound.

Then, a tall and handsome figure, an animal that looked like a dog or wolf, and a man with brown skin strode over.

It was Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam.

When Abraham saw them, he endured the pain of his broken leg and said, “t’s you…”

With a wave of his hand, a golden light shot out.

The golden light circled around Abraham.

Then, his severed right leg grew back at a speed visible to the naked eye.

In just a dozen seconds, he actually grew a new leg.

[Skill: Advanced Radiance of Life!]

Abraham looked at his newly grown right leg and was slightly stunned.

Then, he stood up in disbelief.

He jumped a few times on the spot.

Finally, he confirmed that his leg had really recovered.

“My leg!” Abraham shouted excitedly. “My leg grew back!

“That’s great!

“That’s great!”

Soon, he thought of Lin Fan’s actions and said, “It was you. You helped me, right?

“It must be you!

“Thank you. Thank you so much, Lin Fan.”

Lin Fan smiled. “You’re welcome.”

Be it Bear Country or Abraham himself, Lin Fan had a good impression of them.

Saving him was just a piece of cake.

At this moment, an emotionless voice sounded.

[First to kill a level-six Desert Golden Scorpion. You’ve obtained a level-six treasure chest.]

[First to kill a level-six Desert Golden Scorpion. Hua Nation’s mineral resources have increased by 10%.]

…

In Bear Country’s live broadcast room.

“Thank you, Lin Fan!” the host said.

Allen: [Who knows how the Desert Golden Scorpion died?]

Marvin: [It’s Lin Fan! It was killed by Lin Fan with a single strike! He’s so powerful!]

Maria: [He killed the Desert Golden Scorpion with one strike and easily let Abraham grow a leg. He’s so handsome! Lin Fan, I love you!]

Hill: [Lin Fan, I want to marry you!]

Aberke: [Lin Fan, I want to hug you to sleep!]

It had to be said that foreigners were more open-minded when it came to expressing their emotions than Hua people.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

“Regrowing limbs?” Xiao Bing was stunned.

Active Person: [F*ck! That’s a divine technique! It’s another divine technique!]

Unnamed Hero: [Invincible! He’s simply invincible!]

Warm Wine: [No wonder God Lin gave the Beginner Radiance of Life to the Heavenly Hound. He probably didn’t even like that thing.]

Stone Man: [He can jump dozens of meters high, freeze the desert, summon divine lightning… And now, he can even regrow limbs! God Lin is awesome!]

Kite: [I used to wonder how someone could solve several math problems and invent high-tech gadgets in various fields! Now, I finally understand. It’s because he’s not human but a god!]

Water: God Lin, when are you coming back to Earth? Please accept me as your disciple, Master Lin!]

Want to Chase Someone: [Please accept me as your disciple!]

W: [Please accept me as your disciple!]

…

Naturally, Lin Fan did not know that many women in Bear Country had started to covet his body. He also did not know that Hua people wanted him to take them as his disciples.

He looked at the level-six treasure chest in front of him and chose to open it.

[You’ve obtained 400 points of spiritual energy. Do you want to use them?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—4,000 points of spiritual energy.]

Then, Lin Fan said to Sam, “Use them.”

With a wave of his hand, the light orb in the treasure chest instantly entered Sam’s body.

In an instant, Sam’s mind became extremely clear, and his entire person seemed to have been sublimated.
